name: independent-mandatory-report-plus-full-translator-v4
hypothesis: An independent evidence specialist improves an otherwise unchanged translation agent when both the exact few-shot examples and the specialist's complete report are mandatory launch-context inputs, while the translator retains full project access and independent research discretion.
activation_condition: For every language, an evidence-only Luna session writes a cited report; a fresh Luna translator then receives the complete ordinary few-shot prompt and the full report embedded directly in its launch context.
fallback: The translator must consider the complete report but may verify, correct, or reject any claim and conduct additional research using the exact examples, tools, and full supplied project.
falsifier: The method fails if it does not improve paired translation quality over the ordinary staged harness, if either the few-shot examples or full report are absent from translator context, or if the translator is prevented from independently verifying and extending the research.
agent_instructions: Two independent agents contribute to the task. RESEARCHER: gather high-value evidence from the supplied examples and project, cite it precisely, and write .runner/report.md without drafting translations. TRANSLATOR: read and consider the complete embedded report and exact few-shot examples before translating. Both are required evidence inputs. The report is not unquestionable authority: verify, correct, or reject its claims and perform any additional project research needed. The target examples define observable vocabulary, grammar, orthography, script, and style.
research_prompt: Act only as an evidence researcher for all three tasks. Inspect the exact few-shot examples, immediate passage context, semantic parallels, and target-side concordances in the supplied project. Write a concise .runner/report.md with one section per task containing source propositions and semantic roles that must survive; the most relevant directly attested source-target evidence with exact row or example citations; genuine conflicts or gaps; and clearly labeled tentative observations. Do not draft or recommend a complete translation. End after the cited report exists.
translation_prompt: Read and consider the complete embedded research report and every supplied few-shot block before translating. Verify material report claims against the examples and project, correct or reject errors, and conduct any further research needed using the local corpus and tools. Produce one coherent translation per task that follows the supplied target examples and preserves every source proposition, participant and semantic role, relation, polarity, quantity, and name. Return only the controller-required structured JSON.
